name: American Near East Refugee Aid (Anera)
mission:
Since 1968, Anera has helped refugees and others hurt by conflicts in the Middle East live with dignity and purpose.
Anera, which has no political or religious affiliation, works on the ground with partners in Palestine (West Bank and Gaza), Lebanon and Jordan. We mobilize resources for immediate emergency relief and for sustainable, long-term health, education, and economic development. Our staff serve in their communities, navigating the politics that constrict progress to get help where it's needed most. That's how Anera delivered more than $100.4 million in programs in 2020 alone, and it's how we will keep building better lives until hope finds its way in the Middle East.
theoryOfChange: Anera was founded in 1968 to respond to the refugee crisis arising out of the 1967 War. There are still hundreds of thousands of refugees in the West Bank, Gaza, Lebanon and Jordan with many more flooding out of Syria as the war continues there. Anera's humanitarian relief work reaches refugees and impoverished, marginalized communities alike.  We strive to ease suffering and help people live with some level of dignity in very trying circumstances.Anera also works to affect sustainable improvements that have an impact long after Anera's intervention ends, whether it is building infrastructure or teaching youths job skills.

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1968, American Near East Refugee Aid (Anera) delivers humanitarian assistance and development programs to refugees and vulnerable communities in the Middle East <cite id="4">with a focus on Palestine, Lebanon, and Jordan</cite>. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="3">$204,317,485 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting significant institutional scale. Anera maintains a strong financial standing with an overall <cite id="1">100/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>. The organization's reported program expense ratio is 96.3%, while its cash-adjusted program ratio stands at 88%, easily exceeding the 75% industry standard. The charity provides direct relief through programs spanning emergency health, food systems, water and sanitation, education, and community livelihoods. While non-cash gifts-in-kind account for 73% of revenue and operating reserves remain lean at 1.2 months of working capital, Anera maintains strong program efficiency and an established track record across Muslim-majority regions.
